## What it is

This is a select collection of writings I produced for a master's course on data ethics.  Throughout the course, we responded to various works related data ethics, including [97 Things About Ethics Everyone in Data Science Should Know](https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/97-things-about/9781492072652/) edited by Bill Franks, [More Than a Glitch](https://mitpress.mit.edu/9780262548328/more-than-a-glitch/) by Meredith Broussard, and [Weapons of Math Destruction](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/241363/weapons-of-math-destruction-by-cathy-oneil/) by Cathy O'Neil.  Responses to these writings and others are included in the "Deep Dive" section.

The course final was a group project wherein myself and two peers produced a *97 Things* style series of essays.  My contribution to the collection is provided under the heading *Secular Morality and Data Ethics*.  In this essay, I reference another essay, *What Hath Tech Wrought*, which is also included here.
